planted.item: The board authorises management to negotiate the Harrowgate renewal with a liability cap not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.
The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from 1 June 2026.
The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature by the end of May.
Petra Voss said: “I will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.”
Whether the board will accept the fee increase for Harrowgate renewal.
The board has not yet agreed on who owns the data the Project Lantern produces.

sources.quote: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

sources.quote: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.
sources.speaker: Anders Holm

items.text: Anders Holm declares an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.

sources.quote: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg notes that the fee increase is steep for a two year term.

sources.quote: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: Erik Nyström suggests asking for a three year term at the current fee instead.

sources.quote: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss states that Harrowgate has not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.

sources.quote: the board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board authorises management to negotiate the Harrowgate renewal with a liability cap not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.

sources.quote: All in favour? That is carried unanimously.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The motion to authorise negotiation of the Harrowgate renewal is carried unanimously.

sources.quote: I will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.

sources.quote: Whether we accept the fee increase at all is still open
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Whether the board will accept the fee increase for Harrowgate renewal.

sources.quote: we should come back to it once we see their answer
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg suggests the board should reconsider the fee increase after receiving Harrowgate's response.

sources.quote: The board resolves to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from the first of June twenty twenty six.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from 1 June 2026.

sources.quote: I will prepare her service agreement for signature by the end of May.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

sources.quote: Item four, Project Lantern. Anders has left the room for this item.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board discussed the budget for Project Lantern.
